events.title: DAX Up Marginally As Tech Strength Offsets Inflation Concerns
events.description: German stocks posted modest gains Wednesday as tech shares rallied following Nvidia's strong earnings. Eurozone inflation accelerated to 4.0% in October, the highest since September 2023, while Brent crude fell 1.1% amid oversupply concerns.

events.title: NVIDIA Q3 Results Surge On Data Center Strength; Board Not To Reinstate Huang As CEO; Stock Gains
events.description: Shares of AI chip major NVIDIA Corp. were gaining around 4 percent in the pre-market activity on the Nasdaq following the announcement of the company's significantly higher third-quarter profit and revenues, on strong demand for its data center products amid AI boom. The company also issued fourth-quarter outlook, and said its next-generation Vera Rubin computing platform has begun shipping.

events.title: Indian Shares End Notably Lower On Profit Taking
events.description: Indian shares fell notably on Wednesday amid profit taking after benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty closed at a nearly nine-month high in the previous session, driven by falling oil prices and continued foreign fund inflows.

events.title: Gold Extends Downward Trend On Rate Hike Worries
events.description: Gold prices faced sustained selling pressure on Wednesday as a stronger dollar and elevated Treasury yields reduced the appeal for non-yielding bullion.

events.title: Indonesia Hikes Key Rate By 25 Bps To Defend Currency
events.description: Indonesia's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point on Wednesday as a pre-emptive move to keep inflation within the target and to stabilize the currency. The board of governors, governed by Destry Damayanti, decided to hike the BI rate to 6.00 percent, the highest since January 2025.

events.title: Oil Prices Tumble On Fears Of Supply Glut
events.description: Oil prices fell sharply on Wednesday as traders weighed renewed fighting in West Asia against expectations of falling U.S. crude oil inventories and signs of recovering supplies, driven by recovering Middle East exports.

events.title: Pound Slides After U.K. Economic Data
events.description: The British pound weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, following the United Kingdom's (UK) mixed inflation-related data releases.

events.title: European Shares Mixed In Cautious Trade
events.description: European stocks were little changed on Wednesday after falling the most in eight months in the previous session on concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Pound Slides Against Majors
events.description: The British pound weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed Despite Nvidia Earnings Beat
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Wednesday despite Wall Street facing a fresh wave of selling pressure overnight on concerns over the artificial intelligence trade and expectations of more aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.

events.title: Malaysia GDP Growth Beats Estimate
events.description: Malaysia's economy grew faster than anticipated in the third quarter with investment and exports serving as key drivers of expansion, official data revealed Wednesday. Gross domestic product expanded 5.5 percent year-on-year, the Department of Statistics said. The rate surpassed the advance estimate of 5.3 percent but came in weaker than the second quarter's 6.0 percent expansion.

events.title: European Shares Set For Softer Open Ahead Of Fed Minutes
events.description: European stocks are seen opening mostly lower on Wednesday as investors await the release of minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee's October meeting later in the day for clues as to whether policymakers are leaning towards another rate increase next month.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Lower In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares opened a tad lower on Wednesday as weak global cues, hawkish Fed remarks and rising tensions in the Middle East prompted traders to lock in profits after recent strong gains.
